snippet.title: Hamburg-Hanover Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT NOW - store.steampowered.com/app/222588

The route from Hamburg to Hanover in Germany is one of the most important railway lines in Lower Saxony, running from the state capital of Hanover to Germany's second largest city, Hamburg. The 153km (95 mile) route sees a busy mix of high speed and commuter passenger trains alongside regional and international freight trains.

From the major transport hub of Hamburg, the route runs south through Harburg, Lüneburg, Uelzen and Celle, passing some of Germany's largest freight yards, including Maschen Marshalling Yard, the largest such facility in Europe and the second largest in the World. Hamburg Docks, Uelzen Metronom Depot and passenger station, Hanover Flughafen underground station and Hanover Nordstadt Bahnhof are just some of the other picturesque features in this spectacular route.

Also included with the Hamburg-Hanover route for Train Simulator 2013 is the DB ICE 2, DB Class 101 and DBAG Class 294 shunter.
